listing.name: EA Sports UFC 4 — UFC4 native Linux (cgodoi) (cgodoi)
listing.summary: The project measured boot, menus and fights at 60 FPS on Lenovo Legion Go with Bazzite. Full career coverage is unknown. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA CUSA14204 base game and update 28.00, merged as documented.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the native tar.gz release or build from source. Supply your own dump and follow the documented hardlink merge.
